segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin mostly report the serum works well without greasiness, though one combination-skin reviewer had a bad reaction — dryness and a rash lasting over a week — after just two days of use.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin are split: some say it hydrates well and pairs nicely with retinol, while several others, including a 77-year-old who cut back to twice-weekly use, found it drying or simply ineffective at hydrating their dry skin.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers mostly tolerate the serum without issue and note it has no noticeable fragrance, though the peppermint oil content is flagged as a possible irritant for very reactive skin and one reviewer's rosacea worsened after about ten days of continued use.
segments.mature: Several reviewers in their 40s, 50s, 70s and one 77-year-old report firmer, plumper-looking skin and reduced fine lines with regular use, describing the line as aimed at more mature skin.
segments.oily: One reviewer whose skin reacts poorly to oily products found this serum agreeable and concludes it can be used on oily skin.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers focused on aging report firmer, plumper skin with reduced fine lines and wrinkles within one to a few weeks, including reviewers in their 40s, 50s and 70s; several others, some after a full month of use, say they saw no improvement in fine lines, firmness or wrinkles.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers describe the serum as hydrating without heaviness, including under retinol and in cold, dry weather; a notable minority with dry skin instead found it under-moisturizing or even drying, with one cutting back to twice-weekly use and another saying it did not hydrate her dry skin at all.
concerns.redness: One combination-skin reviewer had a bad reaction — dryness and a rash lasting over a week — after two days of use, and another saw her rosacea worsen with continued use; a third reviewer instead reports a reduction in facial redness after two weeks.
concerns.spots: Two reviewers report fading dark spots and more even, hyperpigmentation-free skin tone after several weeks of use.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer confirms the serum caused no breakouts during use.

aspects.libelle: Can feel tacky before fully absorbed
Can pill unless given time to absorb

extraits.texte: Honestly not sure what to say here as I was excited to receive these products but I had a very very bad reaction to it. It dried my skin out and left a rash for over a week. Had to stop using it after 2 days. I have combo skin and no allergies Received free for my honest review.

I received the Advanced Total Correct Serum free from Exuviance in exchange for my honest review. I loved that this serum is not fragranced and when used as directed there was no sensitivity. However, it absorbs super quickly, and I found that typically one pump was not enough to do my entire face and neck. ￼ I received and used these products for 30 days. I did not see improvement in any of my fine lines or wrinkles or any firming of the skin. Past experience with antiaging products would say that I probably need a little more time to see any true effectiveness. I have normal skin that leans more dry. I found that this serum did not provide a ton of moisture. Therefore, it didn't play very well under make up. On occasions it's filled up as well. ￼If you have more of an oily skin situation going on, you may love these products. If you are more dry this may be a no go for you. This will not be a product that I will be re-purchasing. Bonus points for the cute packaging.

extraits.titre: Excellent for twice a week only.
extraits.texte: I'm 77 years young with mixed to dry skin. I was using the serum every day and noticed that it was drying somewhat my skin, so now I use it only twice a week and wear the moisturizer on top. Exuviance is an excellent brand of products that really works and you can feel and tell the difference in a week.

I received this product free in exchange for my honest review. I generally really enjoyed this product. The Advanced Total Correct Serum made my skin (gently) peel more than any skincare I've ever used. Within 8 hours on day one, I noticed peeling and skin on my chin and forehead gently rubbed off upon firm pressure. My skin feels softer and more fresh. However, while I love it, I am noticing a worsening of my rosacea after 1.5 weeks of use so I switched to using it every other night. I plan to continue to use it though and it's perfect for a skin refresh! Note: it does contain peppermint oil so I do not advise for sensitive skin.

I'm thoroughly impressed with Exuviance Advanced Total Correct Serum! This potent serum has been a game-changer for my skin, delivering noticeable results in just a few short weeks. Its lightweight, non-greasy texture absorbs quickly, making it perfect for daily use. The transformation has been remarkable - fine lines and wrinkles appear smoother, dark spots and hyperpigmentation are fading, and my complexion looks brighter and more even. My skin feels hydrated, plump, and supple, with a noticeable improvement in texture and tone. What I love most is how effortlessly it fits into my skincare routine, layering seamlessly under moisturizer and makeup. The results speak for themselves - I've received countless compliments on my glowing skin! I highly recommend Exuviance Advanced Total Correct Serum to anyone seeking to address fine lines, dark spots, uneven skin tone, and hydration. It's a must-have in any skincare arsenal.
